title: Visa Slot Scam Panic Room
oneLiner: A recovery checklist for applicants who used a slot broker and need to protect accounts, money, and evidence fast.
targetUser: Visa applicants and families who paid a broker, lost portal access, or suspect a WhatsApp/Telegram appointment scam.
keyUx: Answer what happened, then get a 30-minute lock-down checklist, evidence folder, official-contact map, and warning post template.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web prototype for "Visa Slot Scam Panic Room". Target user: visa applicants who paid a slot broker, lost portal access, or suspect a WhatsApp/Telegram appointment scam. Core UX: the user answers a short incident triage, then receives a prioritized account lock-down checklist, evidence vault, official contact map, payment dispute notes, and a community warning draft. Required sections: panic summary, incident triage cards, 30-minute checklist, evidence vault mock, official channel map, payment dispute notes, and shareable warning draft. Use the calm-consumer design profile: reassuring hierarchy, gentle accent, clear recovery steps, high-legibility forms, and no sensational scam graphics.

sourceSignals.source: Reddit r/Scams: US/Canada visa appointment scam
sourceSignals.evidence: Applicants report slot brokers holding accounts hostage and removing victims from large WhatsApp groups.
sourceSignals.action: Victims scramble to recover portal access, document payment, and warn others.
